notes: Photo of a printed sheet (JPG, no text layer), skewed and perspective-distorted but legible. Date: sample collected 07:35 on 20/05/2024 and result returned 11:10 on the same day, so the date is 2024-05-20 (day-first). Decimal COMMA in results and ranges: '5,6' means 5.6. Results and ranges are kept verbatim as strings with the comma (not converted to floats), so a comma-aware normalizer is needed to compare them. Flags: only Creatinin (112), AST (52) and ALT (61) carry a printed H. Glucose, Ure and Acid uric have no flag and all sit inside their printed ranges, so flag null. The flag column has no header. Row name 'Acid uric' is printed as is (should be 'Uric acid', kept verbatim). Printed units: 'µmol/L' (the glyph may be the Greek mu; it is written as the micro sign here). Patient name printed in capitals. Ordering doctor 'BS. Hoàng Đức Nhân', birth year 1979 and sample code LK-240520-0347 are not schema fields.
